note: This file is a pure MMDetection configuration file with no callable functions, classes, or methods. It defines a model dictionary that overrides the backbone to ResNeXt-101 32x4d for a Mask R-CNN FPN detector trained with multi-scale poly augmentation on COCO for 3x schedule. No CLI-invocable code exists in this file.
summarize_config: summarize the Mask R-CNN ResNeXt-101 32x4d FPN configuration for COCO instance segmentation
review_backbone_override: review the ResNeXt-101 backbone override configuration with 32 groups and base width 4
review_base_imports: review the read_base imports for ms_poly_3x_coco_instance and mask_rcnn_r50_fpn base configs
review_pretrained_init: review the PretrainedInit configuration using open-mmlab resnext101_32x4d checkpoint
review_model_dict: review the model dictionary defining backbone depth, stages, frozen stages, and norm settings
